title: Exploring the psychology of LLMs' Moral and Legal Reasoning
benchmark_measurement: The paper measured the weight that Large Language Models assign to different fundamental moral values using the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ). This included the 'Purity/Sanctity' foundation, which is strongly associated with religious concepts of sacredness, divinity, and avoiding spiritual contamination.
findings: In the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ) study, all tested models except Llama 2 Chat 70b attributed significantly lower relevance to the Purity/Sanctity foundation compared to humans. This suggests that the models place less weight on moral considerations related to sacredness and spiritual purity, which are often central to religious worldviews.
